track_event.name: track_event
track_event.description: Send a track event to Pendo.

type.description: The type/name of the track event.

visitorId.description: The unique identifier for the visitor.

accountId.description: The account identifier the visitor belongs to.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to the current time if not provided.

properties.description: Additional key-value properties for the event.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a custom track event to Pendo for a given visitor (and optionally an account), recording product-usage activity for analytics. Choose this to log a behavioral/usage event; requires an event type/name and a visitor ID, with optional account ID, millisecond timestamp (defaults to now), and arbitrary event properties. Not idempotent — each call appends a new event.

get_visitor.name: get_visitor
get_visitor.description: Retrieve details of a visitor by their ID.

visitorId.description: The unique identifier for the visitor.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Pendo visitor by their unique visitor ID and returns that visitor record. Use when you have a specific visitor identifier and need their metadata/attributes. Read-only and idempotent.

get_account.name: get_account
get_account.description: Retrieve details of an account by its ID.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Pendo account by its unique account ID and returns that account record. Use when you have a specific account identifier and need its metadata/attributes. Read-only and idempotent.

list_guides.name: list_guides
list_guides.description: Retrieve all guides from your Pendo account.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all in-app guides configured in the authenticated Pendo account. Use to enumerate guides or to discover a guide ID for use in other steps. Takes no input. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
